$schema_description: Machine-readable workflow rule definitions for the maintenance/service CRM data model (Accounts, Maintenance Requests, Maintenance Offers, Maintenance Touchpoints, Service Engagements). Companion file to data_structure.json.

workflow_rules.note: Trigger value written as 'Data Entry Face' in source description — assumed to mean the 'Data Entry' status value; confirm exact picklist value.
workflow_rules.description: Fires when a Maintenance Request's Status is changed to Data Entry; updates related service usage data (likely refreshing rollups/fields on the related Service Engagement and/or Maintenance Offer).
Fires on creation of a Maintenance Offer; runs the MO Create Services function to auto-generate the associated Service Engagement record(s).

workflow_rules.trigger_condition: when Total Used field is modified
workflow_rules.description: Fires when the Total Used field on a Maintenance Offer changes; runs the MO Total Used Changed function.
workflow_rules.related_fields_note: Total_Used is not part of the previously documented Maintenance Offers rollup fields (Hard_Refusal_Count, Last_Touchpoint_Date, Last_Used_Date, Service_Engagement_Count, Used_Services); it may be a separate field driving or driven by Used_Services — confirm relationship.

workflow_rules.description: Fires when a Service Engagement's Total_Turnover rollup field changes; runs the MSSE Total Turnover function (likely propagates the value up to the related Maintenance Offer or Account).

workflow_rules.trigger_condition: when Times Used field is modified
workflow_rules.description: Fires when a Service Engagement's Times_Used rollup field changes; runs the MSSE Total Used Rollup function (likely propagates/aggregates usage counts up to the related Maintenance Offer's Total_Used / Used_Services fields).
Fires on creation of a Maintenance Touchpoint; runs the MS Touchpoint Workflow function (likely updates rollups such as Hard_Refusal_Count / Last_Touchpoint_Date on the related Maintenance Offer).

assumptions_and_open_questions: Rule 1's trigger condition 'Status is modified to Data Entry Face' is assumed to mean status = 'Data Entry'; the exact picklist value should be confirmed.

Rule 3 references a 'Total Used' field on Maintenance Offers that wasn't included in the previously defined rollup fields; its relationship to the existing Used_Services / Service_Engagement_Count rollups is unclear and likely relevant to resolving the earlier flagged ambiguity between those two fields.

Function names are treated as opaque references to backend logic (e.g. custom functions/deluge scripts); no internal implementation details were provided or assumed beyond the stated trigger and likely effect.
